950-4613-6857.easyPrerequisites:
Kragma Butcher doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Fatestitcher is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
950-4613-6857.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
950-4613-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Kragma Butcher
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2438-4681-5170-8175.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

4381-4694-7306-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-7306-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

3055-3175-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3055-3175-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2021-2060-2445-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

5759-6779-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
5759-6779-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Screaming Nemesis indestructible using Selfless Spirit.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5759-6779-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

1682-2092-4954.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
1682-2092-4954.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2263-2511-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1636-5371-5475-7629.description:
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Hourglass of the Lost.
Repeat.
1636-5371-5475-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

Resolve Daydream, blinking Possessed Skaab

Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

206-3259-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.

Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{U}.

You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
428-1694-2719-2736.description:

Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.
